name: Elective Affinities: Miró & Contemporaries
description: Explore the fascinating dialogue between 24 works by the master Joan Miró and 53 pieces from the Serralves Collection by contemporary artists.
longDescription:
"Elective Affinities: Miró & Contemporaries" is an art exhibition at Casa de Serralves, presenting a curated conversation between the works of Joan Miró and a selection of pieces from the Serralves Collection. The exhibition features 24 works by Miró, juxtaposed with 53 works by contemporary artists, exploring thematic and aesthetic connections across different eras and artistic practices. This curatorial approach aims to highlight shared sensibilities and influences, fostering a dialogue between the historical avant-garde and modern art.

Visitors to Casa de Serralves will encounter a focused presentation of art within the grand setting of the museum. The exhibition is designed for art enthusiasts and those interested in modern and contemporary art, offering an opportunity to observe the interplay between a master's oeuvre and subsequent artistic developments. The exhibition runs for one week, from June 4th to June 10th, 2026, allowing for multiple visits or a single in-depth exploration.

Tickets for "Elective Affinities" are available for purchase at Casa de Serralves. The venue is accessible by bus, with several routes stopping near the Serralves Foundation. It is also reachable by taxi or ride-sharing services from central Porto. Information regarding specific bus lines and accessibility features can be found on the Serralves Foundation website.
